item.title: Equilibrium 39th Community Call Recap
item.dc:creator: Equilibrium
item.content:encoded:
On December 19th, Equilibrium threw another Community Call after a long delay since the beginning of the year. Alex, Equilibrium’s CEO, hosted an hour-long session with an extensive Q&A section at the end.

The call addressed pressing issues following the expiration of Equilibrium’s parachain slot, which led to users’ funds being inaccessible. The team issued an apology for the communication lapses and outlined plans to enable user withdrawals by Q1 2025, utilizing their own funds to facilitate refunds for approximately 99% of users.

Alex highlighted technical challenges faced due to resource constraints and ecosystem updates, confirming a permanent exit from the Polkadot ecosystem. Key points included discussions about the upcoming interface for withdrawal requests, clarification on staking rewards, and future project initiatives promising allocations for EQ and Q token holders.

Closing remarks emphasized a commitment to community satisfaction and an upcoming aftermath call in Q1 2025 to share further updates while ensuring ongoing support through Discord for specific user inquiries.

Let’s navigate through the main topics of the event.

Challenges that led to sunsetting Equilibrium

The expiration of the parachain slot led to a downtime for the Equilibrium project starting at the end of January 2024.

Unfortunately, efforts to renew the slot through parachain auctions were unsuccessful, and the network was halted. The inability to renew the slot resulted in funds being stuck in the non-functional parachain, causing significant reputational damage.

The team lacked sufficient developer resources to implement necessary updates and maintain the codebase, which has become increasingly complex with recent Substrate and Polakdot updates that didn’t support backward compatibility. Alex emphasized that rough minimum estimations were a two-month full-time involvement of a full-scale dev team.

The project has faced challenges in raising additional funding, particularly during the bear market, limiting the ability to sustain operations and relaunch the parachain.

Withdrawals will become available in Q1 2025

The plan to enable withdrawals for users in Q1 2025 includes the following key points:

  • Users will be able to sign a request through a special UI on the Equilibrium website to facilitate the withdrawal of their funds.
  • The team will use their own funds to reimburse users based on the balances recorded at the time of the withdrawal process.
  • A snapshot of all signatures will be taken after a designated period, ensuring that refunds are processed for those who have committed to the withdrawal plan.

As mentioned above, the team expects to satisfy withdrawal requests from 99% of the users. The team will announce the launch of the dedicated UI in Equilibrium’s socials — stay tuned!

EQ & Q holders are eligible for future giveaways!

Alex mentioned that the team doesn’t give up and keeps working through innovations in the DeFi space.

Amid the decision not to return to the Polkadot ecosystem at the same scale as before, the team is cooking up some new cool stuff that will go live across other prominent blockchain platforms. These new initiatives leverage the team’s exclusive expertise in building sophisticated DeFi products and advanced skills in a broad technology stack.

The team aims to ensure that Equilibrium investors and EQ/Q token holders receive allocations or airdrops as part of the new initiatives. We will reveal details in Q1 2025 and expect that our loyal supporters will be compensated through these future opportunities.

Wrapping up

The team flagged potential problems caused by parachain expiration to Parity and asked for clarifications regarding their Parathread developments way before this risk materialized. We never got a clear explanation and the Agile Coretime update went live months after our parachain got stuck.

However, it’s eventually our failure, and it would be incompetent to blame third parties for these circumstances. As such, the EQ team takes full responsibility for the inconvenience caused by the downtime of the parachain, and we are committed to taking further steps to resolve the current situation.

We also acknowledge the disappointment and frustration of the community due to the lack of communication over the past months. The team will ensure that users are informed about future developments and withdrawal processes.

Please stay tuned!

item.title: Equilibrium 38th Community Call Recap
item.dc:creator: Equilibrium
item.content:encoded:
What a way to kickstart our community call for the year!

Alex (our CEO) solely led the first edition of our 2024 community call as Peter (our project manager) was away on his annual leave. He cleared the community’s doubts about the halted withdrawals and transfers and fielded many questions.

Without further ado, let’s get into the details.

Next steps towards our parachain renewal

If you’ve been having difficulty moving your funds around (within and outside Equilibrium), it’s because our parachain slot expired on Jan 16th, and the renewal process has been quite a pain. XCM transfers are also currently unavailable. But rest assured, we’re taking an ‘all hands are on deck’ approach to resolving the situation.

Before the slot expiration, we suspended on-chain transfers on the backend, so it will be easy to re-enable transfers once the parachain goes back live. This will help our users who deposited funds in our DeFi pools avoid any undesired margin calls.

Next steps

We’re currently looking for a potential slot swap. Talks with ecosystem partners who are not using their slots are underway, and we hope to strike a deal soon. We’re working tirelessly to relaunch the parachain earlier than April this year (which is when the current batch of parachain options will be concluded).

The second step we’re taking is a crowdloan: this is currently in progress. So far, we’ve collected over 5500 $DOT and are thankful to the 125+ participants who have supported us. You can also support us (more details ahead).

Before relaunching the parachain, we’ll offer a grace period to everyone with positions in our parachain and any of our DeFi products: this will allow you to revise your balances and conservation ratios and top up your balances to avoid margin calls.

We’ll also revise balances as we’re currently conducting the redemption of DOT against xDOT. Another thing we need to do is make sure that the EQ transfers initiated after the parachain suspension are completed before the parachain relaunch to re-enable the easy transfers of assets.

Our crowdloan is live on Polkadot

Our crowdloan is officially live, and we have set a cap of 50,000 $DOT for this crowdloan. We’ll be distributing 1M Q tokens to our community, and for every DOT you submit, you will receive 20 Q tokens.

You can participate in this crowdloan campaign using some of the most established wallets in the Polkadot ecosystem: Talisman, Subwallet, and NOVA wallets. Other platforms like parachains.info and Bifrost also support our crowdloan.

Another way to support us is by participating via polkadot.js here.

Bifrost supports our Polkadot crowdloan

We’re thankful to our partner — Bifrost — for supporting our crowdloan through their #SALP mechanism. For every DOT you contribute on their website toward our crowdloan, you’ll get vsDOT. Your vsDOT can be leveraged for EQD stablecoins and used as collateral on other lending protocols. They grant you access to its dual liquidity functionality.

But that’s not all! You’ll still receive the normal 20 Q reward for every DOT you contribute while unlocking the liquidity of staked DOT: having your DOT liquidity despite locking up your DOT.

You can join our crowdloan via Bifrost here.

You can redeem DOT using xDOT2 now

For now, we have shifted to another mode of redeeming DOT using xDOT2. Visit the claim page and submit your request while waiting for the next withdrawal batch. The claim page is available here: https://app.equilibrium.io/swap-dot

If you have your xDOT2 on Genshiro, you don’t need to transfer it to Equilibrium manually. Go to the claim page and follow the instructions. For now, all withdrawals will be processed weekly, but we can amend this schedule later.

EQ — Q swap recap

We have concluded the 2-week EQ — Q swap using these proposed swap rates;

500 EQ for 1Q

4,000 GENS for 1Q

300 EQ + 0.001 DOT for 1Q

Currently, we’ve burned 21.5% of supplied EQ tokens. The 164 participants have claimed almost 3.3M Q tokens. These were the submissions;

1.4B EQ tokens

1178 DOT

2.3M GENS

Based on these stats, we’re excited to relaunch the tokenomics of our project. The tokenomics will unlock more opportunities for both the platform and grant users access to more liquidity, incentives, and resources while opening up opportunities for more ecosystem collaboration. We believe this to be a step toward a healthier economics for the project.

Remember that the only way to get Q tokens now is through our crowdloan.

The reverse swap has been concluded

Another important milestone for us was completing the DOT distribution for our reverse swap, available for PLO phase 1 participants between January 16th and 23rd.

NOTE: If you contacted our support team because you couldn’t participate during the swap, please contact our Discord community moderators to provide further instructions.

EQ.finance was spotted on #PolkadotDapps

We have been participating in different community activities: one of them was the #PolkadotDapps: an initiative by Polkadot to put together an overview of the DeFi space. One of their Twitter mega threads mentioned us in the liquid staking section.

The mega thread is available here.

We’ve participated in Polkadot Twitter spaces on Liquid staking

We explained everything you need to know about liquid staking to the whole of the Polkadot community on their Twitter spaces.

Alex gave his perspective on Polkadot’s mechanism of liquid staking, in which there are many players and no major actor to capture most of the liquid staking.

Other participants in the space were Sushant (Taiga Protocol), Tyron (Bifrost), Travis (Acala), Gaius (Algem), and Nicolas (Parity).

You can replay the chat here.

Development updates

Here are some of the projects we’ve completed between December and January.

We prepared for the expiration of our parachain slot by freezing assets so that transfers can be quickly restored once we relaunch the parachain. To do this, we prepared some migrations and deployed them on chain.

We also launched an in-house Ethereum bridge to enable EQ transfers from the Ethereum network back to Equilibrium. In preparation for the EQ — Q swap, we decided to burn some supply of EQ tokens to ensure the tokens in our treasury will not be affected by the swap.

If you missed it, we deployed a webpage for the EQ — Q swap and kicked off the actual swap on the 2nd of January. We also built the UI for xDOT2/DOT redemption, so you can utilize it to claim your xDOT2. And we are sorry for the last-minute change of this mechanics.

Over the month, we fixed an issue with XCM transfers between Equilibrium and Moonbeam. We also started the operation for our Q tokenomics — this will happen when we get our parachain slot back up and running on Polkadot.

Wrapping Up

We apologize for every inconvenience you’ve faced with moving your funds around over the month. We’re working tirelessly to renew our parachain slot lease and fix the issue. Thanks for reading, and we look forward to you joining the next call.

Also, keep an eye out on our X (Twitter) channel and Discord. Every piece of information first goes out on these platforms!

About EQ.finance

EQ.finance is the first liquid DOT hub of the Polkadot ecosystem. It enables liquid DOT holders to leverage their LDOT, vDOT, eqDOT and other wrappers for dollar-pegged EQD stablecoins. EQD is the first interest-bearing decentralized stablecoin of the Polkadot ecosystem. It is collateralized by a weighted basket of assets and can be used as a universal unit of value within the DeFi ecosystem. eqDOT is a liquid DOT staking wrapper that allows users to participate in DeFi on Polkadot while earning DOT staking yield.

item.title: EQ.finance crowdloan is live, 1M Q allocated for rewards
item.dc:creator: Equilibrium
item.content:encoded:
EQ.finance joins the ongoing batch of parachain auctions with its crowdloan campaign. In this campaign we seek 50,000 DOT staked for two years for our parachain. To reward participants, we’ve allocated a significant fraction of the Q supply to reward participants: 1M Q tokens which equals 0.83% of the overall supply.

This article breaks down the mechanics and explains why it’s attractive to DOT holders to participate. Let’s take a deeper dive together.

What is a Crowdloan?

As you may know, Polkadot crowdloans are a widely-known mechanisms through which participants can lend or contribute their DOT to support specific projects or parachains seeking to secure a slot on the Polkadot network. During a crowdloan, contributors lock up their DOT tokens for two years, effectively “loaning” them to a parachain project of their choice. In return for this support, participants are typically offered incentives, such as native tokens of the parachain project or other rewards.

The crowdloan mechanism allows parachain projects to attract the necessary DOT backing to secure a parachain slot, fostering a decentralized and community-driven approach to network expansion. It also enables DOT holders to actively participate in the growth and development of the Polkadot ecosystem while earning rewards for their contributions.

EQ.finance Crowdloan Details

Here’s all the information you need to get up to speed with Equilibrium’s upcoming crowdloan in one place:

Note, we reserve the right to allocate additional rewards during the campaign that can be distributed in a form bonuses.

What is Q?

New Q tokenomics (Qnomics) represent a significant shift in the economic model of EQ.finance. A portion of Q tokens was initially distributed through the EQ → Q swap conducted recently.

As we covered in our previous articles, the relaunch of project’s tokenomics unlocks multiple opportunities to scale EQD as an ecosystem decentralized stablecoin that leverages Liquid Staked Tokens (LSTs) of Polkadot. The list of supported LSTs includes but not limited to the most established liquid staking providers — Acala, Bifrost, and Taiga Protocol.

Alongside previously conducted swap, the crowdloan is one of the only ways to get Q tokens in your wallet. You can learn more about Qnomics from this article.

How to participate in the crowdloan

  • Mobile wallet Nova allows users to contribute from the Nova Wallet App
  • Polkadot.js allows users to directly lock their DOT directly on the relay chain.
  • Another way to participate is on parachains.info website
  • Some desktop wallets, such as Talisman and Subwallet allow their users to participate in crowdloans as well.

item.title: xDOT2 claim and next steps towards our parachain renewal
item.dc:creator: Equilibrium
item.content:encoded:
As the lease for the second batch of parachains has ended on Polkadot, crowdloan refunds started to go through to parachain supporters. There were a lot of them who participated in the second batch of crowdloans through xDOT — a mechanism introduced by Equilibrium a while ago. This mechanism helped crowdloan participants get xDOT wrappers against every DOT contributed to crowdloans, while xDOT could be widely used as liquidity in our DeFi product line. This article breaks down the next steps for participants in the second batch.

Total available for claim: 563,693 DOT

Wait until the claim page goes live

Crowdloaners who contributed through Equilibrium will be able to redeem their DOT by returning xDOT2 tokens soon. As Equilibrium’s parachain slot is still to be renewed, we will need to collect cryptographically signed permissions to subtract xDOT2 balances once the parachain is onboarded on Polakdot again. The claim page will be released no later than the week of January 22, 2024.

Sign a transaction on the claim page

We will announce the launch of the claim page on our socials. Then, xDOT2 holders must navigate to this webpage and use the address they have participated in crowdloans to sign a transaction.

Suppose your xDOT2 sits in the former Equilibrium parachain. In that case, this transaction will enable us to subtract the free balance of xDOT2 that was not locked in lending pools previously and submit a DOT withdrawal.

If your xDOT2 is in Genshiro, you don’t need to transfer your holdings to the former Equilibrium parachain any longer. The claim page will offer to sign a transfer of xDOT2 to our dedicated address, and your DOT redemption will be accepted for the next tranche.

Receive redeemed DOT in the next withdrawal batch

We will withdraw DOT in batches based on redeem transactions collected from our users during the week prior to the current withdrawal. DOT will be returned to the same addresses where claim transactions came from. As such, users should expect slight delays in DOT withdrawals after they submit transactions on the claim page. Respectively, this delay will be one week at maximum.

Steps towards our parachain renewal

As the next step to secure our next parachian slot on Polkadot, we will launch a new crowdloan campaign and communicate its details with the community. We acknowledge that transactions on the former Equilibrium’s parachain are currently disabled due to the end of the parachain lease. We are making all possible efforts to resolve this issue immediately.

item.title: A deep dive into a brand new Qnomics
item.dc:creator: Equilibrium
item.content:encoded:
TL;DR

This article explores the tokenomics of the new Q token, designed to substitute EQ tokens in Equilibrium. The primary purpose of this shift is to relaunch the project’s financial model and support the rise of its EQD stablecoin. Q will help to activate liquidity incentives, unlock strategic partnerships, and renew the lease of a parachian slot on Polkadot. The design of the Q token reflects the specifics of the EQ.finance product line with EQD stablecoin as its key. Q tokenomics introduces staking mechanics that direct a fraction of protocol income to the staking pool.

Why are we doing this shift?

The rationale behind these amendments was extensively covered in this article earlier. To reiterate its main thesis, the Polkadot ecosystem is experiencing substantial rebuilding, and we are shifting our focus toward servicing the market of Liquid Staking Derivatives to reflect these changes.

Ecosystem fundamentals support these amendments. Polkadot has one of the highest inflation rates among all DPoS chains, currently at around 18% APR and over 40% of the DOT supply stake. As said, this alone provides the basis for Liquid Staking Derivatives in the ecosystem.

To be successful on this route, we need to ensure that the project economy can sustain pivoting the product vision and drive the further success of the renewed product offering. As we can recall, the current EQ tokenomics seems to be a weak basis due to:

  • Lack of reasonable liquidity incentives
  • Unclear perspective for parachain slot renewals
  • Inability to cover user acquisition costs
  • Uncertainty of further project funding

As such, we’ve come up with a plan to relaunch tokenomics by substituting existing EQ tokens with new Q tokens. The Q tokenomics (Qnomics) design improves on all the above and accounts for the financial specifics behind the main product — EQD stablecoin. It also introduces vast staking opportunities for Q holders and empowers them to participate in the protocol governance. This article gives a comprehensive overview of Q and the ways how it improves the current status quo.

How EQD issuance drives Qnomics

Here’s what the high-level diagram of the protocol business model looks like:

Let’s look at the above diagram from the perspective of every system participant:

  1. Borrowers mint EQD stablecoin against a variety of collateral assets. To manage their credit position, borrowers pay variable interest rates in accordance with the risk profile of their position. Borrowers pay interest in Q tokens. Borrowers can purchase Q tokens in advance in the Q/USDT AMM or have their collateral sold periodically for Q tokens in the Q/USDT AMM.
  2. Insurers provide liquidity and ensure the stability of the EQD stablecoin in case of borrowers default. Insurers receive 80% of the interest borrowers pay. During the liquidation process, the borrower’s obligations are transferred to insurers, and insurers secure repayments with their liquidity and receive collateral assets from the defaulted borrower.
  3. Q token stakers. Stake Q tokens and receive 20% of the interest paid by borrowers. Can use staked tokens in governance decisions for the protocol.

From the protocol management perspective, the process above ensures the balance among liquidity pools that help maintain price stability for the native Q token. Potential price fluctuations can only occur if there is a delay between the purchase of the Q token by borrowers and its sale by insurers.

Stability pool

We’ve introduced the Stability pool to prevent sharp price fluctuations. This pool contains a certain Q token allocation and USDT. This pool automatically smoothes out the situation in case of increased demand for the Q token when current holders cannot satisfy it. In this way, the buying pressure is redistributed and the collected USDT is used for the reverse situation when demand cannot meet supply.

The stabilization pool is designed to reduce internal inflation among token holders and provides a fair interest rate relative to the dollar, which protects participants from hyperinflation.

We’ve performed quantitive modeling to evaluate the dependency between EQD and Q performance and demonstrate how the Stability pool smoothes out the volatility curve. Here is the list of the initial parameters for the model:

Smooth increase in the volume of EQD minted throughout the year and its subsequent retention:

Here’s how our model reflects Q FDV based on the above parameters. Note that a Stability pool is activated at the mark of $0.3 per Q, which has kept FDV from growing before then. After investors started dumping Q to the market, the pool was activated to accumulate tokens within the protocol again:

Staking mechanics

Here are some highlights of the Q token staking mechanics.

1. Protocol calculates staking quota to target 16% APR in USD terms. If total Q staking doesn’t reach the quota, the effective APR will be higher than 16% APR. On the other hand, if the quota is filled completely, no more Q staking is allowed.

Protocol calculates the current quota in real-time on every user action and allows or disallows Q staking. Here is a formula for the quota:

fee — 20% of interest fee payable to stakers
r — current interest rate

r_tgt — target interest of 16 APR%
Pq — the price of Q token

Quota grows with the rise of the EQD supply (more debt = more rewards) and with the rise of interest rate r. The quota drops when the Q token price rises.

2. The actual reward users receive depends on several factors:

a) The amount of Q tokens locked

b) The length of the lock.

c) Value of EQD minted

d) Value of the Insurance collateral

The exact formula is way too complex to be presented here. Deriving the formula involved careful crafting of factor loadings (weights) to maximize rewards when medium-size and small-size Q token holders lock their tokens for a longer duration.

3. Users may lock their tokens for the following periods and enjoy the governance voting power multiplier along with the increased rewards (the reward weight grows approximately linearly with the lock time).

Here we treat 1 month as 28 days and call it an epoch. Users lock their tokens for the lock period starting the next epoch during the current epoch. Users who have locked tokens in this epoch start to receive rewards in the next epoch.

4. Users can claim the Q token rewards earned for the epoch after the epoch ends.

Q token distribution

The table below shows the final token distributions with details on cliff and vesting mechanics provided in the last column.

The Token Swap

As the community has voted in favor of the token swap, we will prepare a separate token swap page where users will be able to swap their EQ tokens for the Q token allocation. The swap will start on January 2, 2024, and last 14 days until January 16, 2024. The exact swap rates are:

  • 1Q = 500 EQ
  • 1Q = 4000 GENS
  • 1Q = 0.001 DOT + 300 EQ

The Q token will become the native token of the EQ.finance parachain after we secure the next parachain slot. The EQ token will, in turn, become a regular parachain asset.

We’ve opened up a bridge between Genshiro and Equilibrium for GENS tokens to facilitate a swap for GENS tokens. Deposit GENS directly to Equilibrium from Equilibrium’s app UI.

To facilitate support for the EQ tokens bridgeable from Ethereum, we’ve opened up a bridge between Ethereum and Equilibrium. We use our own bridge (Chainsafe’s pallets) for the lack of alternative / easier-to-use options.

Final remarks

We’ve spent substantial time and effort to develop a system with enough checks and balances to sustain the potential growth of the liquid staking derivatives market in the Polkadot ecosystem. As usual, the protocol’s success will depend on numerous factors, including the general user perception and support. But the main driving factor for the entire system we propose is, of course, the circulating supply of the EQD stablecoin: the wider EQD is adopted across the ecosystem, the more use cases it has, the more EQD there is in existence, the more fees are recycled in the protocol.

EQ.finance is set in a perfect position to ignite the native stablecoin of Polkadot finally!

item.title: 37th Community Call: Y2023 roundup, Qnomics, Polkadot crowdloan
item.dc:creator: Equilibrium
item.content:encoded:
2023 was filled with many exciting events at Equilibrium and the entire crypto community. Our last community call of the year presented us with the perfect opportunity to reflect on all our achievements and projects of the year.

Our previous Community Call #36 focused on the EQ.finance launch and our new Q token and tokenomics reboot. The latter dominated the discourse in this community call, too. So buckle up if you’d love to get more updates about it!

As usual, Alex Melikhov, our CEO, led the call over a virtual cup of coffee with Peter Sergeev, our Sr. Project manager.

Without further ado, let’s dive into it.

Referendum #7 results

If you missed our last community call, you may have yet to learn about the launch of our new tokenomics. But don't worry: here’s what you may have missed, including development updates.

We recently concluded our 7th referendum on our governance portal on PolkAssembly after a 2-week long community voting schedule. The agenda was for our community members to express their approval or disapproval by ballot over the launch of our new Q token’s tokenomics (this Q token is designed to substitute EQ token in EQ.finance).

The turnout was impressive: approximately 214 million EQ tokens (votes) were cast, making it our most active community voting so far. However, it was a neck-and-neck race, as 52% of voters voted to favor the new token and tokenomics change. And as usual, vox populi: hence, we’re moving forward with the community’s choice. All the same, a special thanks to every community member who participated in this voting round.

In response to the vote, we’ve changed some structures of the proposal and will notify you of the changes soon.

Qnomics roadmap

Given that the proposal has passed, we’re revealing our Qnomics roadmap and the transition from the current tokenomics to the new one;

The first step toward the launch of the new tokenomics is the burning of the EQ tokens in our treasury, which is underway. We’ll kick off the EQ and Q swap on 2nd Jan and conclude the transition by 16th January 2024. Within this period, you can submit your EQ tokens to be exchanged for the new Q tokens.

In Q1 2024, we expect to secure a Polkadot parachain slot and begin the distribution of Q tokens, so everyone who participated in this swap will get their Q tokens.

The most exciting thing about this shift is that we’ll be able to launch liquidity campaigns that will support our primary goal of enhancing the protocol’s liquidity and that of EQD stablecoin (which we expect to be the ecosystem’s decentralized stablecoin). This will also help liquid DOT holders get instant dollar liquidity and help us unlock more partnership campaigns with our Polkadot ecosystem partners.

We’re building a dedicated webpage for this and will share the link on our socials and website, so keep an eye out.

EQ.finance Polkadot crowdloan is live

Another BIG announcement you should be aware of is the launch of our crowdloan on Polkadot. Participating in this launch is another way of getting Q tokens besides swapping your EQ tokens.

We’ve capped the crowdloan at 50,000 $DOT and will allocate 1 million Q tokens for this event. We’ve sweetened the deal for you: for every $DOT you lock in our crowdloan, you’ll get 20 $Q tokens.

You can participate using any of these supported Polkadot-based wallets: Talisman wallet, NOVA wallet, and Subwallet. You can also participate on Parachains.info or by scanning this QR code to go to polkadot.js.

EQ-Q Swap mechanics

Here’s a breakdown of the swap rate if you participate;

  • You’ll get 1 Q token for every 500 EQ tokens. The vesting period for this is 90 days cliff and 270 days of linear vesting. This means you’ll get your Q tokens on the 90th day of vesting.
  • $GENS holders can swap their $GENS token for $Q and get 1 $Q for every 4000 GENS. The vesting schedule is 180 days cliff and 360 for linear vesting.
  • The most attractive way to participate in this campaign is by contributing both EQ and DOT tokens. When you contribute 300 EQ and 0.001 DOT, you’ll get 1 $Q token. The vesting schedule is the same as contributing only EQ tokens.

These rates were picked based on the community’s feedback.

NOTE: The swap starts from the 2nd of January to the 16th of January.

Y2023 recap

2023 was particularly engaging for us and the entire crypto space as we spent most of it in a rollercoaster bear cycle. However, with the positive activities in the market right now, we hope the worst is behind us.

Now, to the juicy part! Here’s a recap of our 2023 year-long achievements and projects!

January

In January, we were most proud of our integration with the major Polkadot ecosystem wallets. We integrated with Talisman, Subwallet, and Fearless wallets, all of which support both EQ and EQD tokens.

These wallets allow you to store and transfer your holdings and use our application on their platforms.

February

February saw us launch our farming campaign, which was an exciting experience. We introduced six strategies, such as minting EQD, staking DOT, swapping EQD and USDC, etc., for users to maximize their APR.

March

March was an exciting month for us as we had listed EQ on several exchanges: Gateio and MEXC. But we didn’t do that without our community’s approval.

EQ started trading on 9th March on both exchanges. So you can trade your EQ tokens for USDT on these exchanges. And if you’d like to participate in the Q swap, you can buy more EQ tokens from them.

April

In April, we launched the ArthSwap pool with an EQD/ASTR pair and introduced a high APR farming campaign of 77%. Also, in April, we joined the league of the top 1% of parachains with the most ecosystem connections.

You can still trade EQD for ASTR on this pool here.

May

We hosted Polka DeFiance in collaboration with the Talisman team. Polka DeFiance is an annual Polkadot event that brings together the most important parachain teams and ecosystem actors to share their opinions on the ecosystem’s activities.

The event attracted 22 teams, 551 registered users, and 17 speakers. And we hope to organize something similar in 2024. Here’s the recap of the event.

June

In June, we participated in Polkadot Decoded in Copenhagen, of which Alex was in attendance. He explained the importance of having a native stablecoin in the Polkadot ecosystem and why EQD is perfectly positioned for this. The experience was exhilarating, and we’re looking forward to 2024’s edition.

August

We got listed on the Beamswap DEX in August and opened a USDT-EQD stableswap pool there so that you can trade EQD: Beamswap is Moonbeam’s DEX.

Moving forward, we’re also looking at setting up pools on Stellar and HydraDX DEXes.

October

We made steps to solve issues with liquid staking derivatives (LSDs). We observed there were not many use cases for LSDs on Polkadot. So we created a way to stake DOT, obtain liquid DOT wrappers, and use them in multiple ways.

We launched EQ.finance to accept different liquid DOT wrappers like lDOT, vDOT, eqDOT, etc., and let users access dollar liquidity as in EQD while earning staking rewards. Currently, this is the only platform to access dollar liquidity this way.

November

In November, we began preparations for developing our Q tokenomics to tackle the limitations of our current tokenomics.

The Q token will become the native asset of EQ.finance as well as our governance token. We’re offering a 16% APR in USD terms. We’re also introducing staking quotas and other parameters to prevent the APR from dropping.

2024: What lies ahead?

Q1 2024: Our focus is on the Q token transition: the swap will take place this January. We’ll also launch the Q staking model and begin Q listings.

Q2 2024: We’ll push EQD and gunning for the ecosystem-wide integration. We also plan to list EQD on CEX. And within the year's first half, we’ll introduce something related to our fiat on-ramp and off-ramp for our stablecoin.

Q3 2024: We’ll introduce leveraged yield trading and principal + coupon stripping. We hope to launch this for every supported wrapped DOT.

Q4 2024: We’re setting our sights on expanding beyond Polkadot to other ecosystems. This will aid our goal for cross-chain interoperability and value extension to other ecosystems.

Wrapping Up

That was how we wrapped chapter 2023. Thanks for all the fantastic experiences and sticking with us all through 2023. We look forward to more ambitious and rewarding projects in 2024.

Have a wonderful new year, and see you in the next community call!

EQD is the first interest-bearing decentralized stablecoin of the Polkadot ecosystem. item.title: Equilibrium activates its strategic shift: EQ → Q swap started
item.dc:creator: Equilibrium
item.content:encoded:
Equilibrium, the major all-in-one Polkadot-based DeFi platform, has started the long-awaited transition of its tokenomics to new rails of brand-new Q tokens. During the next two weeks, starting today, January 2, all holders of ‘old’ EQ tokens can swap them for Q and be the first to obtain stakes in the renewed project’s economy. Participants can submit DOT on top of their EQ stakes to get a better swap rate.

Here’s what you need to know:

This paradigm shift aligns with Equilibrium’s pivotal focus on Polkadot’s Liquid Staked Derivatives and the recent launch of EQ.finance, a liquid DOT hub of Polkadot. The EQ.finance hub runs the only decentralized interest-bearing stablecoin in the Polkadot ecosystem called EQD. Relaunch of the tokenomics unlocks attractive liquidity incentives for new EQD users and strategic partnerships with liquid staking service providers.

Qnomics introduces a 120M Q token supply that will be vested with a maximum lockup period of three years. Q token model is largely concentrated on EQD mechanics and liquidity incentives for the protocol. Q holders will enjoy extensive staking opportunities for their holdings and staking Q pool will receive a significant fraction of the protocol revenue streams. You can explore Qnomics in greater detail in our latest article here.

Equilibrium’s community decided on these significant changes during referendum #7. The referendum occurred in December 2023, and 52% of its participants expressed their support for the tokenomics amendments through decentralized voting. The results of the referendum are available at the Equilibrium’s governance portal.

The ongoing swap also accepts GENS tokens of Genshiro, Equilibrium’s sister project on the Kusama network. The swap rate for GENS holders is 4,000 GENS per 1 Q, while the lockup period is twice longer: 180 days cliff + 360 days vesting.

item.title: Announcing New Equilibrium’s EQ.finance Crowdloan
item.dc:creator: Equilibrium
item.content:encoded:
What is a Crowdloan?

By way of reminder, a Polkadot crowdloan is a widely-known mechanism through which participants can lend or contribute their DOT to support specific projects or parachains seeking to secure a slot on the Polkadot network. During a crowdloan, contributors lock up their DOT tokens for two years, effectively “loaning” them to a parachain project of their choice. In return for this support, participants are typically offered incentives, such as native tokens of the parachain project or other rewards.

The crowdloan mechanism allows parachain projects to attract the necessary DOT backing to secure a parachain slot, fostering a decentralized and community-driven approach to network expansion. It also enables DOT holders to actively participate in the growth and development of the Polkadot ecosystem while earning rewards for their contributions.

EQ.finance Crowdloan Details

Here’s all the information you need to get up to speed with Equilibrium’s upcoming crowdloan in one place:

A quick lowdown on Q

As the landscape of the Dotsama ecosystem shifts, so does Equilibrium. The most recent change is the big tokenomics overhaul introducing a switch from EQ to Q. This is done in an effort to better position EQ.finance at the forefront of Polkadot’s liquid staking derivatives space where Equilibrium’s key offering is the minting of EQD stablecoin with LSD assets.

We’ve provided a comprehensive breakdown of Q tokenomics in this article and explained how Q enhances the Equilibrium ecosystem. In a nutshell, Q is designed to relaunch the Equilibrium’s tokenomics and unlock multiple opportunities, including liquidity inflows and promotional activities.

As you may already know from the previous article, 1 million Q is allocated towards the crowdloan. This allocation represents 0.83% of the total supply of Q.

How to participate in the crowdloan

  • Mobile wallet Nova allows users to contribute from the Nova Wallet App
  • Polkadot.js allows users to directly lock their DOT directly on the relay chain.
  • Another way to participate is on parachains.info website
  • Some desktop wallets, such as Talisman and Subwallet allow their users to participate in crowdloans as well.

item.title: Introducing Q Token and Enhancing Equilibrium’s Ecosystem
item.dc:creator: Equilibrium
item.content:encoded:
Abstract: This proposal outlines a strategic shift in Equilibrium’s tokenomics by introducing a new token, Q, and a corresponding substitution mechanism for EQ and Q tokens. The initiative addresses current challenges and positions Equilibrium as a leader in the Polkadot ecosystem’s liquid staking derivatives space.

Introduction: Ever since the inception of Equilibrium, our vision has been to establish it as the premier DeFi platform within the Polkadot ecosystem. However, despite our technological advancements and unique offerings, the current Polkadot environment prompted a reevaluation. The Polkadot ecosystem’s focus on application chains and the growing popularity of Liquid Staking Derivatives has shifted priorities, leading us to propose a token swap and introduce Q tokens.

Rationale for Token Substitution: The substitution of EQ with the Q token is suggested because of changes in the Polkadot ecosystem and shifting our focus to servicing the market of Liquid Staking Derivatives. Polkadot has one of the highest inflation rates among all DPoS chains, currently at around 18% APR and over 40% of the DOT supply staked. This alone provides the basis for Liquid Staking Derivatives in the Polkadot ecosystem.

Various protocols are involved in providing derivatives on users’ staked DOT. Acala, Bifrost, Parallel, Equilibrium, Taiga, and most recently, Stellaswap on Moonbeam offer different versions of Liquid Staked Dots with their own mechanics:

  • Acala LDOT (18% APR) — 4.5M DOT staked
  • Parallel sDOT (18% APR) — 1.5M DOT staked
  • Bifrost vDOT (23% APR) — 3.5M DOT staked
  • Equilibrium eqDOT(12% APR) — 26K DOT staked
  • Taiga tDOT (14.51% APR) — 1.8M DOT staked
  • Stellaswap stDOT (18.4% APR) — 34.1K DOT staked

With a high inflation rate in DPoS staking, creating Liquid Staking Derivatives (LSD) ecosystem-native stablecoin becomes crucial. Equilibrium, now rebranded as EQ.finance, is poised to capitalize on this opportunity by offering a decentralized EQD stablecoin minting using LSD collateral and introducing the Q token.

Q Tokenomics and Utilities: We meticulously designed the tokenomics, prioritizing inclusivity and stakeholder interests. It reflects our most comprehensive approach yet, involving months of work, two third-party analyst teams, scenario modeling, and alignment efforts. Notably, the Q token’s team allocation is minimal and locked for 3 years, underlining our enduring commitment to the protocol and user community.

The following table shows the allocation breakdown and respective unlock schedules.

Total supply = 120,000,000 Q tokens.

The Q token is pivotal, replacing EQ in governing the Equilibrium parachain. Users can stake Q tokens for 1 to 720 days, earning a share of stablecoin borrowers’ interest fees — 80% to the insurance fund and 20% to Q token stakers. This built-in interest mechanism stimulates Q token demand, cyclically reinforcing DOT liquidity in the Q/DOT or Q/USDT AMM pool.

Notably, our staking mechanics employ a dynamic quota targeting a fixed APR in USD. This quota adjusts based on Q token price and EQD stablecoin circulation: higher prices reduce the quota and vice versa. A forthcoming article will elaborate further insights into quota and staking mechanics.

Governance Vote and Swap Procedure on the EQ <> Q token swap: To facilitate the token swap, forum discussions will begin on November 20 and will last until November 29. Governance vote will be conducted after and will last for 7 days here: https://equilibrium.polkassembly.io/. If the vote passes, the swap procedure will commence shortly and last 14 days. Users can participate in the swap through a dedicated page, with optimal rates offered for EQ + DOT token combinations. The collected DOT tokens will be channeled into the AMM liquidity to support the EQ token price.

Here are the proposed swap rates:

Implications of the Vote: In the event of a favorable vote, the EQ token will be phased out, and Q will become the primary currency of Equilibrium and EQ.finance. Conversely, if users decide against the swap, EQ token will remain the primary currency.

Parachain Auction and Q Token Distribution: Right after the swap, a parachain auction will be launched in the first trimester of December, aiming to secure Equilibrium’s parachain slot extension. For this purpose, 1 million Q tokens will be distributed, subject to a 360-day cliff and 360-day linear vesting.

Conclusion: This proposal outlines a comprehensive strategy to enhance Equilibrium’s ecosystem by introducing the Q token and implementing a governance-driven swap mechanism. The evolution aligns with the changing dynamics of the Polkadot ecosystem and positions Equilibrium as a frontrunner in the emerging liquid staking derivatives space.

Equilibrium is a one-stop DeFi platform on Polkadot that allows for high leverage in trading and borrowing digital assets. It combines a full-fledged money market with an orderbook-based DEX. EQ is the native utility token that is used for communal governance of Equilibrium. Dollar-pegged EQD is Equilibrium’s native decentralized stablecoin, collateralized by a weighted basket of assets and used as a universal unit of value within the DeFi ecosystem. eqDOT is a liquid DOT staking wrapper that allows users to participate in DeFi on Equilibrium while earning DOT staking yield.

item.title: Equilibrium 35th Community Call Recap
item.dc:creator: Equilibrium
item.content:encoded:
For our 35th community call, Alex Melikhov (our CEO), sat down with Peter Sergeev (our product manager and business analyst) to shed more light on our LSD portal and its impact on liquid DOT staking in Polkadot and beyond.

There were lots of interesting takeaways. Let’s get into it.

Ultimate LSD portal for Polkadot

In our last community call, we outlined our roadmap for rolling out the liquid-staked DOT (LSD) app. We thought of introducing interesting use cases for DOT wrappers so they’re more useful for their holders on Polkadot. An example is creating several DOT staking opportunities in which users can stake their DOT and get a DOT wrapper in return (like eqDOT: Equilibrium’s DOT wrapper) without waiting for 28 days to pull out the staked DOT. Initially, when you stake your DOT, you lose access to its liquidity because it’s locked within the staking mechanism. This is the same with liquid staking, except that you could swap your LSD for DOT. But that was just it: there were not many prominent use cases for LSD on Polkadot.

We’re changing the game by allowing you to mint EQD stablecoin while maintaining access to your DOT liquidity. You can generate EQD stablecoin using your liquid DOT wrappers as collateral and use the stablecoins within the Polkadot ecosystem.

In November, we will begin third-party integrations. We’ve already teased our airdrop campaigns with our partners, so follow us closely and don’t miss out!

Here’s some insider information: We are currently working on something special that will be a breath of fresh air in the Equilibrium ecosystem. More details are coming soon. Based on our arrangement with some of the top ecosystem players, we’re super confident this will change everything.

Polkadot’s LSD portal UI demo

Peter walked us through a short presentation to give us a feel of the UI. You can already try it out yourself, as we’ve released the portal on a different domain name from Equilibrium: https://eq.finance/

DOT wrappers supported on the portal are Equilibrium’s eqDOT, Acala’s LDOT, Parallel’s sDOT, Bifrost’s vDOT and Taiga’s tDOT which will be available soon. Also, you can now get DOT wrappers directly from Acala and Bifrost to mint EQD stablecoin on the EQ Finance portal.

We’re so excited about the release!

EQD use cases

Since you’ll be minting EQD with your DOT wrappers, here’s a refresher on how to use your EQD;

Liquidity provision

  • Mint EQD against collateral of more than 30 different tokens supported on Equilibrium’s EQD stableswap pool.
  • Bridge native USDT from Asset Hub, provide liquidity into the pool, and earn fees when users swap stablecoins.

3rd party pools

  • We support the ArthSwap pool where you can swap the EQD/DOT and EQD/ASTR pairs. We also support Beamswap’s stableswap pool for swapping EQD for USDT.

Other use cases

We’re working on more integrations and use cases to make EQD the ecosystem’s primary stablecoin. One of the top use cases will be the Banxa off-ramp where you can get self-service collateralized loans and swap your EQD for fiat for your daily use.

Crowdloan batch 1 DOT return update

Recently Polkadot experienced a big unlock of the first batch of Crowdloan DOT.

If you used our liquid xDOT solution for crowdloans and voted for Clover, Acala, Astar, or Parallel, you can now swap your xDOT and cDOT in just a couple of clicks.

We’ve released an in-app UI to give users a seamless experience swapping their xDOT and cDOT. After signing your transaction within the app, your xDOT and cDOT collateral, liabilities, and pool deposits will be automatically converted into DOT in a 1:1 ratio.

You can access all these features in one click rather than going through hoops on Parallel or other protocols.

Swap here: https://app.equilibrium.io/swap-dot

QUICK ONE: If you’ve got your xDOT sitting in Genshiro, you’ll need to bridge them from Genshiro to Equilibrium. Simply follow the instructions on deposit flow on the Equilibrium app.

Development updates

We’ve been super busy working on the LSD hub UI/UX work and DOT reverse swap.

We also had lots of runtime upgrades, fixed XCM issues, supported new wrappers, and made some Multilocation updates.

We’ve added support for the tDOT wrapper from the Taiga protocol, making it five DOT wrappers that’ll be supported on our platform.

To wrap up the meeting, we announced the crowdloan Genshiro won. We encourage you to bridge your DOT to Equilibrium to get your crowdloan DOT back.

Q&A Session

Watch the recap of Q&A with the EQ community here.

We hope you enjoyed the gathering, and we look forward to seeing you on the next Community Call!
